## Summary

Financial claims and recommendations below are attributed to this September 25, 2026 report and its supplied September 24 technical snapshot. They are preserved historical claims, forecasts and conditions, not current market facts.[^gpso-c8b53800c8dec568]

Rank 1 is No actionable strategy because exact entry, executable stop and quantifiable improvement thresholds are missing. The IDR 250 completed-close boundary is not a guaranteed stop fill. Rank 2 rejects an oversold breakout above 258 requiring volume/PVO improvement and cessation of CMF/OBV deterioration. No dated evidence supports Armed or Triggered state. A signal only permits later-session consideration, and a final-session closing signal cannot fit the window. Conditional profit zones are 266–280 and 280–290. The 260/250/280 illustration gives 2.0:1 gross and 33.33% binary break-even, but remains non-executable and net economics are unknown. A future qualifying entry would need holding-session 2 follow-through. Adverse financing/related-party news or a close below 250 invalidates the thesis.[^gpso-c8b53800c8dec568]

The report keeps signals separate from fills: Waiting is the stated cut-off condition; Armed/Triggered need fresh dated observations, Active needs explicit entry execution, and Completed needs fills closing the full position. Target touches or exit deadlines alone do not prove execution. Terminal scenario probabilities cannot establish conditional target/stop/fill probabilities, so strategy expected value is not reliably estimable. Unknown costs are not zero and capital, currency-risk, lot and execution inputs do not support a share quantity.[^gpso-c8b53800c8dec568]
